q.en: Which of the following is the first of the Four Noble Truths of Buddhism?
q.as: তলৰ কোনটো বৌদ্ধ ধৰ্মৰ চতুৰাৰ্য সত্যৰ প্ৰথম?

options.en: The world is full of suffering
There is a path to end suffering

explanation.en: The first Noble Truth states that the world is full of suffering (dukkha), the starting point of the Buddha's teaching.
explanation.as: প্ৰথম আৰ্য সত্য কয় যে জগত দুখেৰে ভৰা (দুখ), যি বুদ্ধৰ শিক্ষাৰ আৰম্ভণি বিন্দু।
